decisions.label: Byte order
evidence: The binary header only makes sense read this way.

decisions.label: Samples per trace
evidence: File size divides exactly into traces of this length.

decisions.label: Sample format
evidence: IBM-normalisation test on 40,000 non-zero samples: 0.00% have a zero leading fraction digit (genuine IBM floats: 0%; IEEE floats: typically 5-10%).
This agrees with the declared format.

decisions.label: Data type
evidence: Bytes 189-192 and 193-196 together give a unique grid position for 100.0% of 1200 sampled traces; the first stays constant for runs of traces while the second steps by 1.
The inline number is also stored in byte(s) 191; byte 189 was chosen as the conventional location.
The crossline number is also stored in byte(s) 195; byte 193 was chosen as the conventional location.
Coordinates in bytes 201 and 205 are an exact linear function of (inline, crossline): residual 1.15% of a bin, a perfect regular grid.
